seo.title: Obesity: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Obesity — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Obesity is excess body fat that increases risk of diabetes, heart disease, and joint problems. Indian populations face cardiometabolic risk at lower BMI thresholds (≥23 kg/m² overweight per ICMR guidelines).
symptoms: Often no symptoms until complications develop
diagnosis: Waist circumference (≥90 cm men, ≥80 cm women — Asian cut-offs)
Screen for diabetes, lipids, fatty liver, sleep apnoea
treatment: GLP-1 agonists or bariatric surgery in selected severe obesity
prevention: Limit sugary drinks and ultra-processed food

faqs.question: What causes Obesity?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Obesity curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Acute shortness of breath at rest
Not typically an emergency unless complication present
